summary: Reverse in place, preserving holes, and return the original array object.

target.notes: Move/swap/delete indexed properties so holes remain holes, mutate the receiver, and return the same receiver identity.

caveats: List<T>.Reverse is only an internal fast path when density and ordinary data properties are proven.
C# Reverse methods commonly return void or lazy sequences, neither matching JS.

tests.name: holes move as holes
tests.input: const a=[,1,2]; a.reverse(); console.log(a.length,0 in a,2 in a);
